verdict.rationale: The Digits Connect API documents batch transaction sync with external-ID idempotence, so users can push many transactions in one operation. That is real bulk-ingestion support, but nothing shows bulk edit, recategorize, approve or delete operations, and the MCP server is read-only. Missing for 10: bulk update/action operations across existing items (e.g., mass recategorization or bulk bill approval), documented batch limits or behavior, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: batch transaction sync with external-ID idempotence
Idempotence and deduplication is handled via the external_id field
Idempotent writes — Send safely and repeatedly — no duplicates, ever
